intent.job_to_be_done: Turn raw text into a visual-led professional PPT system: style, spatial briefs, generated slide images, and an image-backed pptx.
target_users: operators producing pitch, strategy, or article-to-PPT decks
agents that must keep whole-deck visual coherence across independently generated slides
inputs: raw article, speech, or briefing text
optional audience, purpose, aspect ratio, page count, fusion ratio
outputs: typography role system with optional T specimens
user-approved local style templates with portable assets and versioned reuse
exclusions: single-page 图文一体化 / 知识卡片
公众号排版输出 or HTML decks (公众号 articles are fine as source material)
generic image prompts unrelated to slides
spreadsheet analysis, video, or legal/financial/medical claims beyond source
